title: Design: Status confirmation has a close X in its title row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active parts for this test, part A and part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 3.3, 3.7, 4.4 and 4.7 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click the X at the right end of the confirmation's title row.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  8. Click Deactivate parts.
  9. Click the part B row.
  10. Click Deactivate on the dark bar.
  11. Click the X at the right end of the confirmation's title row.
  12. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 3:

  • The Inactive radio is filled blue.

Step 4:

  • The "Deactivate part?" confirmation opens with a grey X at the right end of its title row.

Step 5:

  • The confirmation closes; Edit Inventory Part shows again with Inactive still picked and the green "Active" pill: nothing was saved.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and part A is still listed on the Active tab.

Step 7:

  • The menu opens.

Step 8:

  • The dark bar appears.

Step 9:

  • Part B is ticked and the badge reads 1.

Step 10:

  • The "Deactivate parts?" confirmation opens with a grey X at the right end of its title row.

Step 11:

  • The confirmation closes; part B is still ticked and still listed on the Active tab.

Step 12:

  • The dark bar and the checkboxes disappear.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • Key Decisions: “Every confirmation is the application's standard dialog. A title, a message, an optional note, Cancel and a confirm button. There is no confirmation word to type.”
  • S10-R2: “The confirmation is the application's standard confirmation dialog. There is no confirmation word to type.”
  • S13-R23: “Cancelling the confirmation saves nothing and returns to the dialog with the picked status kept.”
  • S10-N1: “If the user cancels the confirmation, no part changes status.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "3.3 Save asks first", "3.7 Bringing it back", "4.4 Confirm", "4.7 Confirm the reactivation". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above, except where this held design case follows the design.

Held design-version case (Rule 130): every status confirmation on the boards has a close X in its title row; the PRD lists a title, a message, an optional note, Cancel and a confirm button only. Question Q8 to Product. Not run until Product rules; if the PRD wins, this case is deleted.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • retire-07-p3-7-activate-confirm.png
  • bulk-04-p4-4-confirm.png
  • bulk-07-p4-7-activate-confirm.png

The design's own words:

  • “Save raises "Deactivate part?" (S10-R1, S10-R3). It opens with the part number and description (S10-R4), then the three lines of S10-R6, then the optional note (S10-R10). The note here reads "Superseded by N6801-06-04X". The red Deactivate button has Cancel to its left (S10-R11). The bulk confirmation (board 4.4) is the same dialog, built from the design system Modal and Button.”
